data.title: Wales start Nations League with home double-header - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Wales will begin next year's Nations League A campaign with back-to-back home fixtures against Iceland and Denmark. Rhian Wilkinson's side will face the Icelandic side on Tuesday, 2 March and take on the Danes four days later. They complete the group with two summer games, at home game against the Italians on Saturday 11, June before a trip to Iceland four days later. Wales are back in the top tier of the Nations League after winning their 2027 Women's World Cup qualifying group. Wales also drew twice with group winners Sweden in that campaign, but finished bottom of the table and were relegated to the second-tier League B. Wilkinson's team will hope next year's Nations League games will form part of preparations for a first appearance at a World Cup. Having beaten Albania 4-0 on aggregate in a World Cup play-off semi-final last month, they face a final against Norway, with the home leg at Cardiff City Stadium on Tuesday, 1 December before an away trip four days later.
